purpose: Combined rate for a place = stack of jurisdictional components
formula: combined = Σ component.rate_value (percent-points), integer micro-units in tie-out
inputs: tax_rates verified rows + official combined totals on extraction items
outputs: tie-out-sales-stack.csv rows with residual vs published total
authority: Texas Tax Code ch. 151 (state) + local ch. 321-327; TX Comptroller combined-rate tables
rounding: storage numeric exact; no rounding in stack; display 6dp (table precision); tolerance 0 micro-units

purpose: Every published fact traces to pinned evidence + three distinct actors
method: Snapshot SHA-256 pins source bytes; DB triggers reject pass verdicts without eligible citation and reject self-approval
formula: publish allowed iff eligible(source) AND extractor ≠ verifier ≠ approver
outputs: verified tax_rates/tax_rules rows with citation + snapshot hash

purpose: Distinguish 'searched, not there' from 'not yet searched'
method: Peer-profile question packs answered found/confirmed_absent/unknown with recorded negative search
elections: unknown is honest default; absence requires recorded search

purpose: Point (lat/long) -> applicable jurisdictions whose published boundary contains it
method: Ray-casting point-in-polygon over WGS84 GeoJSON, bbox prefilter; boundary point counts inside (flagged); test point never rounded
formula: applicable = { j : PIP(boundary_j, point) } ordered by level rank; feeds RATE-STACK
inputs: jurisdiction_geo verified rows (geometry_hash per row) + point
outputs: geo resolve envelope with calc versions + deciding geometry hashes
authority: Boundary as published by US Census Bureau TIGER/Line (TIGERweb) / Texas GIS, cited per row
rounding: coordinates numeric(9,6) storage; simplification tolerance recorded per geometry; no rounding in containment
elections: centroid-only jurisdictions never claim containment; unpublished SPD/transit boundaries are confirmed_absent, never drawn
